verses.text: Ay jun k'u, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' filisteo t'a Soco, t'a yol yik Judá, yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel. Ix sb'o scampamento heb' t'a Efes-damim, t'a snanhal Soco chi' yet' Azeca.
Hanhejtona' pax winhaj Saúl, ix smolb'ejpax sb'a winh yet' heb' yetisraelal t'a sch'olanil Ela, yik smakan sat heb' filisteo chi' heb'.
Ayek' heb' filisteo chi' t'a jun tzalan, haxo t'a junxo tzalan ayek' heb' israel chi'. Ay jun ch'olan aykan t'a snanhal heb'.
Ix elta jun winh soldado t'a skal heb' filisteo chi', te niwan yelk'och winh t'a skal heb', te cha'anh ste'el winh, ay am oxe'ok metro ste'el winh, Goliat sb'i winh, aj chonhab' Gat winh.
Ha t'a sjolom winh ayk'e jun k'e'en xumpil nab'a bronce, haxo pax t'a snhi' sk'o'ol winh ayoch jun k'e'en coraza nab'a bronce paxi. Ay am oye'ok arroba yalil jun k'e'en coraza chi'.
Aypaxoch k'e'en bronce t'a sat spenek winh, yet'nak k'e'en kotak lanza winh t'a yich spatik.
Haxo ste'al yok k'e'en slanza winh yet'nak chi', te niwan spatik, haxo k'e'en hierro ayoch t'a snhi', ek'to 13 libra yalil. Haxo t'a yichanh winh b'ab'el sb'at winh et'jinak smaklab' jul-lab'.

Sjawi tek'tek' winh t'a yichanh heb' soldado israel, te cha'anh tz'awajk'eta winh, syalan winh: --¿Tas yuj t'a stzolal tzex komon ajelta heyak'an owal? Ha hin tik filisteo hin, ha hexxo soldado hex winhaj Saúl. Ha tikne'ik, sik'ekelta junok winak t'a he kal chi', yik tz'emta winh yak' owal wet'ok.
Tato stechaj yak'an owal wet'ok, tato tzin smilchamok, ha honh tik ol honh ochkan he chekab'ok, palta tato ha hin tzin milcham jun winh chi' jun, ha hexxo tzex ochkan ko chekab'ok.
Tato ay junok winak t'a he kal ha hex israel hex tik skot yak' owal wet' tikne'ik, kotokab'i, ol kak'an owal, xchi winh filisteo chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl yet' masanil heb' soldado tas ix yal winh chi', ix te tak sk'o'ol heb' yuj xiwelal.
Ha t'a yol stiempo'al winhaj Saúl chi', ay jun winh t'a Belén t'a yol yik Judá skuchan Isaí, te icham winakxo winh, wajxakwanh yuninal winh. Ha t'a skal heb' winh chi' ay jun winh skuchan David.
Ay oxwanh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' ayoch soldado'al yuj winhaj Saúl chi', ha winhaj Eliab b'ab'el, schab'il winhaj Abinadab, yoxil winhaj Sama. Slajwub' uninxo winhaj David chi'.
Ha winhaj David chi', ay b'aj xit'ek' winh b'aj ay winhaj Saúl chi', smeltzajxi winh t'a Belén yik sb'at stanhwan nok' skalnel winh smam winh chi'.
Ha winh filisteo chi', junjun k'inhib'alil yet' junjun yemk'uhalil ayul winh sb'uchan heb' israel chi'. 40 k'uhal ix sk'ulej winh icha chi'.
Ay jun k'u ix yal winhaj Isaí chi' t'a winhaj David chi': --Ik'b'at ox almulok ixim trigo tik yet' lajunhe'ok ixim pan, b'at ilan heb' winh uk'tak chi'.

Tzik'anb'at lajunhe'ok nok' queso t'a winh yajalil heb' winh uk'tak chi'. Tz'ilani tato wach' sk'o'ol heb' winh uk'tak chi'. Tzik'ankot junok tas sch'oxnab'ilok tato yel wach' sk'o'ol heb' winh, xchi winh.
Ha t'a sch'olanil Ela ayek' winhaj Saúl yet' heb' yuk'tak winhaj David chi' yet' masanil heb' soldado israel yik syak' owal heb' yet' heb' filisteo chi'.

Ayik ix sakb'inaj t'a junxo k'u, ix yak'ankan nok' skalnel winhaj David chi' t'a junxo stanhwumal, ix b'at winh, ix yik'anb'at tastak ix schek winh smam winh chi' yik'b'ati. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a scampamento heb' soldado israel chi', wanxo sb'at heb' yak' owal chi', wan yel yaw heb' sb'at heb'.
Ix sb'o'anoch tzolan sb'a heb', hanheja' ichapax chi' ix yutej sb'a heb' filisteo chi'.
T'a elanhchamel ix yak'kan tastak yet'nak winhaj David chi' ab'enal t'a junok heb' stanhwan scampamento heb', ix b'at winh b'aj tzolanoch heb' chi', ix sk'anb'an winh tas yaj heb' winh yuk'tak chi'.

Ayik wan slolon winh yet' heb', ix elixta winh filisteo aj chonhab' Gat chi', winh niwan yelk'och t'a skal heb' yetfilisteo'al chi', ix syamanxi'och winh sb'uchan heb' israel chi' icha t'a junjun k'u. Ix yab' winhaj David chi' masanil tas ix yal winh chi'.
Ayik ix yilan winh filisteo chi' heb' israel chi', ix te xiwk'e heb', ix el lemnaj heb' t'a winh.

Ay heb' ix halani: Ina winh ix elta t'a skal heb' filisteo chi', sb'uchwaj winh t'ayonh ha honh israel honh tik. Ix yal winh rey, tato ay mach syak' ganar smilancham jun winak tik, te niwan b'eyumal ol yak' winh t'ay, syak'anpax ix yisil winh yetb'eyumok, haxo heb' sk'ab' yok maxtzak stuplaj heb' t'a winh rey chi', xchi heb'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj David t'a heb' ayek' t'a stz'ey: --¿Tas tz'ak'ji t'a junok mach tz'ak'an ganar smilancham winh filisteo chi', yik syaktej winh honh sb'uchani? ¿Tas yaj jun winh ch'ok chonhab'il chi', yuj chi' sb'uchwaj winh t'a heb' soldado yik Dios Pitzan? xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi heb' icha ix yutej yalan t'a sb'ab'elal tas tz'ak'ji t'a junok mach smilancham jun winh ajk'o'ol chi'.

Ayik wan sk'anb'an winhaj David chi' t'a heb' ix halan chi', ix yab'an winhaj Eliab winh yuk'tak winh, ix te kot yowal winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --¿Tas tzul ha k'ulej t'a tik? ¿Mach ix ak'kan yil jaywanh nok' ha kalnel t'a tzinan lu'um chi'? Wojtak to niwan elk'och ha na'ani, palta chuk ha pensar, tonhej tzul il tas tz'aj yoch owal tik, xchi winh.
--¿Tom ay tas wan hex wutan jun? ¿Tom ay yowalil hin k'anb'ani? xchi winhaj David chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at sk'anb'an winh t'a junxo winh. Hanheja' icha chi' ix yutej junxo winh chi' yalan t'a winh.
Haxo heb' ix ab'an tas ix yal winhaj David chi', ix b'at heb' yal t'a winhaj Saúl chi', yuj chi' ix awtaj winhaj David chi' yuj winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi': --Mamin, mokab' chab'ax ha k'o'ol yuj jun winh filisteo chi'. Ol hin b'at ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, ol wak' owal yet' winh, xchi winh.
--Max yal-laj ha b'at ak' owal yet' jun winh filisteo chi', yujto kelem unin hach, palta ha jun winh chi', toxonton ak'um owal winh yiktax ix kotoch winh kelemal, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, ayik tzin tanhwan nok' skalnel winh hin mam, ay b'aj sjawi nok' choj, ma nok' oso yik tzul yik'anb'at nok' kalnel chi' nok',
tzin b'at t'a spatik nok', tzin tok'anek' nok' kalnel chi' t'a nok'. Tato skot nok' t'ayin, tzin och yub'naj t'a yalanh sti' nok', tzin milancham nok'.
Yuj chi', taxonhej ha junok nok' choj, ma junok nok' oso, schamnhej nok' wu'uj. Icha chi' ol wutej jun winh ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. ¿Tas yuj sb'uchwaj winh t'a heb' soldado yik Dios Pitzan?

Ha Jehová tzin kolan t'a nok' choj yet' t'a nok' oso chi', hanheja' ol hin kolan t'a jun winh filisteo chi', xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh: --Ixik an, a'okab' Jehová ol och het'ok, xchi winh.

Elanhchamel ix yik'el spichul winhaj Saúl yik owal ayoch yuj, ix schekan winh ak'jokoch t'a winhaj David chi'. Ix ak'jik'e jun k'e'en xumpil nab'a bronce t'a sjolom winh, ix ak'jipaxoch jun k'e'en coraza t'a snhi' sk'o'ol winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch jachan k'e'en espada winh t'a snanhal, ix yak'lan winh sb'eyi. Maj yal-laj sb'ey winh yet'ok, yujto manh k'ajanok winh. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. --Max yal-laj hin b'ey yet' juntzanh tik, manh hin k'ajanoklaj yet'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix yik'el masanil juntzanh chi' winh t'ay, ix b'at winh b'i'an.

Anhej jun te' sk'okoch winh ix yik'a', ix sik'ank'e oye' k'olan k'e'en k'e'en winh t'a sti' ha ha', ix yak'anem k'e'en winh t'a yol jun syune' pa, yet'nak jun ch'anh mejme'ech winh, ix snitzanb'at sb'a winh t'a slak'anil jun winh filisteo chi'.
Hanheja' jun winh filisteo chi', ix snitzkot sb'a winh t'a slak'anil winhaj David chi', b'ab'el jun winh et'jinak smaklab' jul-lab' winh yuj.
Ayik ix iljikot winhaj David chi' yuj jun winh filisteo chi', ix yilan winh to te wach' yilji sniwanil winh, palta malaj yelk'och winh t'a winh, yujto kelem unin winh.
Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winhaj David chi': --¿Tom tz'i' hin tzila' yuj chi' tzach kot t'ayin yet' te' ha te' chi'? xchi winh. Ix syamanoch winh skatab'an winhaj David chi' t'a sb'i sdiosal.
Ix yalan winh: --Kotanh t'a tik, ol wak' ha chib'ejal schib'at nok' ostok yet' nok' chi'um nok', xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Ha hach tik tzach kot ak' owal wet'ok yet' k'e'en espada yet' k'e'en ha lanza yet' pax k'e'en ha kotak lanza. Ha hinxo tik tzin jawi wak' owal het'ok yet' spoder Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ko Diosal ha honh soldado israel honh tik, haton malaj yelk'och halani.

Ha tikne'ik, ha Jehová ol hach ak'anoch t'a yol hin k'ab'. Ol hach hin milchamok, ol hin xikanel ha jolom. Ol wak'anpax sniwanil heb' etchonhab' tik schib'at nok' ostok yet' nok' chi'um nok'. Icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik to ha ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik, Dios t'a wal yel.

Masanil heb' anima molanek' tik, ol nachajel yuj heb' to manhok k'e'en espada, manhok k'e'en lanza syak'lab'ej Jehová yik skolanel heb' schonhab'. Ha jun owal tik yik Jehová, ha' ol hex ak'anoch t'a yol ko k'ab', xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix kot winh filisteo chi' t'a yichanh winhaj David chi', hanheja' winhaj David chi' elanhchamel ix b'atpax winh t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yak'anemb'at sk'ab' winhaj David chi' t'a yol spa, ix yik'ank'eta jun k'e'en k'e'en winh, ix yak'anoch k'e'en winh t'a yol smejme'ech chi', ix sjulan k'e'en winh. Ha wal t'a snanhal sat winh filisteo chi' ix och k'e'en, ix kan ch'apnaj k'e'en t'a snanhal sat winh chi', ix telwi winh, lachan ix aj winh t'a sat lu'um.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'ji ganar winh yuj winhaj David chi'. Anhej yet' jun k'olan k'e'en k'e'en yet' jun ch'anh mejme'ech ix milji winh yuj winh. Malaj yespada winhaj David chi',

yuj chi' ix b'at lemnaj winh b'aj ayek' winh filisteo chi', ix yik'ank'eta k'e'en yespada winh winh t'a yol yatut. Ha yet' k'e'en ix xikel sjolom winh filisteo chi' winh. Ayik ix yilan heb' filisteo to toxo ix cham jun winh niwan yelk'och t'a skal heb' chi', ix el lemnaj heb'.

Haxo yik ix yilan heb' soldado Israel yet' heb' yik Judá, ix el yaw heb', ix b'at heb' t'a spatik heb' filisteo chi', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a sti' chonhab' Ecrón. T'a masanil yoltak b'e sb'atnhej t'a Saaraim, sk'och t'a Gat yet' t'a Ecrón chi', toxonhej teltumb'a ix ajkan sniwanil heb' soldado filisteo schami.
Ixlajwi sb'at tzak'an heb' israel t'a spatik heb' filisteo t'a juntzanh lugar chi', ix meltzaj heb' yik'elta masanil tastak ay t'a yol scampamento heb' filisteo chi'.
Ix yik'ank'e sjolom jun filisteo chi' winhaj David chi', ix yik'anb'at winh t'a Jerusalén. Ix yik'anpaxel k'e'en syamk'ab' winh filisteo chi' winh, ix yak'anoch k'e'en winh t'a yol smantiado.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Saúl sb'at winhaj David yak' owal yet' winh filisteo chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Abner, yajalil heb' soldado: --Abner, ¿mach smam jun winh kelem tik? xchi winh.
Mamin rey, manh wojtakoklaj, xchi winhaj Abner chi'. --Skan t'a yol ha k'ab' ha k'anb'ani mach ay yik winh, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ayik wan smeltzaj winhaj David chi', ayik toxo ix chamkan winh filisteo chi' yuj winh, yet'nak sjolom winh chi' winh, haxo winhaj Abner ix ik'anb'at winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh: --Hach kelem, ¿mach ha mam? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi': --Yuninal hin winhaj Isaí, winh ha chekab' kajan t'a Belén, xchi winh.
